## Why this matters
PR #396 was merged to `main` on 2026-06-14 without closing its R81 audit findings. This issue tracks the outstanding follow-up work. Feature is behind `FEATURE_COMMUNITY_CLASSROOM_POSTS` (default-OFF) so there is no production blast radius today, but the PR is not R81-clean and cannot be flag-flipped until findings are closed.

## What's required
- [ ] **F1 (P2)** Create-time media storage keys embed a throwaway `randomUUID()` as `{postId}` segment instead of the persisted post id — `src/community/classroom/community-classroom.service.ts:238-255,346-363,462` — fix: generate post id before building create-path media seeds; pass same id into both Prisma create data and `buildMediaSeeds`; add regression test asserting create-path keys include the persisted post id
- [ ] **F2 (P2)** Media arrays are unbounded on both create and attach DTOs — `src/community/classroom/community-classroom.dto.ts:166-170,207-211` — fix: add `CLASSROOM_MEDIA_MAX_ITEMS` constant and `@ArrayMaxSize(CLASSROOM_MEDIA_MAX_ITEMS)` to both DTO properties; add rejection tests
- [ ] **F3 (P2)** Three classroom telemetry names (`classroomLessonPublished`, `classroomLessonScheduled`, `classroomMediaUploadIssued`) are registered and pinned with no classroom emit site — `src/community/community-events.ts:79-84` — fix: inject analytics service into `CommunityClassroomService` and emit events behind `FEATURE_COMMUNITY_TELEMETRY`; add service tests
- [ ] **F4 (P2)** Signed-URL-bearing read routes `listFeed` and `getOne` have no explicit `@Throttle` — `src/community/classroom/community-classroom.controller.ts:50-167` — fix: add explicit `@Throttle` decorators to both read handlers; add metadata regression spec
- [ ] **F5 (P3)** Two test-only `@ts-expect-error` directives remain — `test/community/classroom/community-classroom.service.spec.ts:157-158`; `test/community/classroom/pinned-ordering.spec.ts:65` — fix: replace partial structural mocks with typed helper factories or narrower interfaces
- [ ] **F6 (P3)** Re-publish/re-schedule preserves original `published_at` ordering anchor — `src/community/classroom/community-classroom.service.ts:406-432`; `src/community/classroom/community-classroom.repository.ts:259-267` — fix: document and test the stable-ordering contract explicitly, or update ordering/publish semantics to use a separate schedule/order timestamp for future releases

## Already resolved
Pre-merge audit + post-merge re-audit complete. Findings list above is verified against current `main`.
